mechanisms.note: Advance rent cheques and a security cheque are distinct; the security-return sentence also names a bank guarantee.
Assignment consent must be read with full-term rent after early vacancy.
Late interest, repair loss and daily holdover are separate heads; no automatic cumulative award.
Repair allocation and normal wear interact with a broad condition waiver and referenced Appendix B.
Payment-breach cancellation, generic cancellation and postal delivery rule are different mechanisms.
Printed term/date range, blank option notice, consent condition and security return interact.
Routine utility and municipal-tax allocation; shared-meter accounting is not established.
Aggregate source does not identify this golden fixture; §9 contains a limited repair-setoff route.
Routine utility allocation in §§5-6 does not itself establish a shared-meter formula.
Reasonable-time entry and advance coordination qualifiers are printed.
Drilling, written permission and ownership of improvements require joint reading.
Tenant third-party damage reimbursement is distinct from ordinary condition/repair duties.
Handwriting was excluded from the sanitized fixture; no handwriting-dependent fact may be inferred.

golden_cross_clause_checks.question: Do stated duration, calendar dates, option timing, landlord consent and security-return timing describe one coherent mechanism?
golden_cross_clause_checks.must_not_assume: That an apparent date discrepancy is a proven operative term without later signed material.

golden_cross_clause_checks.question: Which instruments pay rent and which secure obligations; does the bank-guarantee return reference concern the deposited cheque or a separate instrument?
golden_cross_clause_checks.must_not_assume: That all cheque/guarantee references describe the same instrument.

golden_cross_clause_checks.question: How do assignment consent and the tenant's remaining-term rent obligation interact if the tenant leaves early?
golden_cross_clause_checks.must_not_assume: A documented alternative exit right or a predicted legal outcome.

golden_cross_clause_checks.question: How do wear and repair allocation qualify the condition waiver, and is referenced Appendix B actually present?
golden_cross_clause_checks.must_not_assume: Contents of an unseen defects appendix or enforceability of any waiver.

golden_cross_clause_checks.question: Distinguish payment-default trigger, general breach cancellation, any actual cure provision and postal delivery from physical eviction.
golden_cross_clause_checks.must_not_assume: That a notice delivery rule is a cure period or an immediate physical eviction power.

golden_cross_clause_checks.question: Separate late interest, damage reimbursement, holdover amount and security realization by triggering event and underlying loss.
golden_cross_clause_checks.must_not_assume: That separate monetary clauses automatically stack or cancel one another.

golden_cross_clause_checks.question: Does third-party damage reimbursement reach the same events as tenant repair duties or a condition acknowledgment?
golden_cross_clause_checks.must_not_assume: That any contractual indemnity conclusively establishes responsibility.
